criteria.required: Malaysian SME-size screening evidence and a published business contact
criteria.hrdCorp: Optional; unverified employer participation is not treated as a confirmed bonus
criteria.employeeEvidence: Company-owned public LinkedIn range 2–10 or 11–50. Self-reported and potentially stale; not government SME certification.
criteria.ownership: Public company type and visible parent/subsidiary information screened, without a paid registry audit. Explicit listed/foreign multinational subsidiaries excluded.
criteria.contact: Email address or telephone published by the company, checked against the cited source. No emails guessed.

limitations: Official SME certification or current exact headcount
HRD Corp employer registration or available levy balance

heldBackExamples.reason: Conflicting profile size and approximately 150 linked employee profiles.
Own contact page identifies ITMAX System Berhad subsidiary.
51–200 published range does not establish service-sector SME headcount.
